recognize_zh: 血片中許多紅血球的血紅素被推擠到一側、另一側留下清亮新月形區域（偏心紅血球 eccentrocyte），另有小而緻密、邊緣不規則的 pyknocyte 及少數標靶細胞；電泳顯示 Hb C 約 38.5%，符合 G6PD 缺乏合併 Hb C 帶因的氧化性溶血。
features: Numerous eccentrocytes: hemoglobin condensed to one side with a sharply demarcated clear crescent at the opposite margin
Pyknocytes: small, dense, irregularly contracted red cells lacking central pallor
Scattered normal platelets and a single mononuclear leukocyte; no spherocyte-predominant or schistocyte pattern
Hemoglobin electrophoresis: Hb A 57.2%, Hb C or variant 38.5%, Hb A2 4.0%, Hb F 0.3%
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows many eccentrocytes with hemoglobin displaced to one side of the cell and a clear crescentic rim, admixed with dense contracted pyknocytes and occasional target cells; schistocytes are not prominent. Platelets are adequate and the single leukocyte in the field is unremarkable. The accompanying hemoglobin electrophoresis shows Hb A 57.2% and a Hb C/variant fraction of 38.5%, consistent with Hb C trait. Findings are consistent with acute oxidant hemolysis, supporting G6PD deficiency with coexisting Hb C trait; confirmation by G6PD enzyme assay after recovery is advised.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes are round, uniformly dense cells lacking the eccentric clear crescent, with a positive osmotic fragility or EMA binding test.

ddx.dx: Hemoglobin C disease or SC disease
ddx.vs: Homozygous Hb C and SC show abundant target cells and intraerythrocytic crystals with Hb C near 50-100%, rather than eccentrocytes with Hb C trait levels.

ddx.dx: Bite cells from Heinz body removal
ddx.vs: Bite cells show a notched concavity at the margin, whereas eccentrocytes retain the membrane with a clear hemoglobin-free zone; both suggest oxidant injury.
Unstable hemoglobins produce similar oxidant morphology but show chronic hemolysis, a positive isopropanol test and a variant peak distinct from Hb C.
